audit.scope: Independent full-Hilbert probabilities for 18 qubits only; larger QASM parsed/transpiled. Native counts include preparation, cost and mixer, without hardware routing.

protocol.selection: Minimum aggregate TRAIN sampled-energy excess, then fewer layers, then expectation before CVaR.
protocol.reference: Independent native interval CP-SAT, one worker, 10s cap; source separate from QUBO compiler.
protocol.budgets: All use the same full assignment domain. Budgets differ: quantum uses 128 exact simulated objective evaluations plus 8192 Born samples; uniform uses 8192 samples; SA uses 8192 proposals and returns 32 replica bests. No equal-compute or runtime-advantage claim.
